source: Pre-registered benchmark (2026-11-21): plain time-series momentum, parameters fixed from the literature, not fitted to this data

preregistration.hypothesis: Crypto perpetuals keep trending at multi-week horizons (time-series momentum): long when the 30-day return in volatility units is above +0.5, short below -0.5, flat when it crosses zero.
preregistration.why_these_parameters: 30-day lookback and 30-day volatility on 4h candles (180 bars) is the standard monthly TSMOM horizon; entry at half a volatility unit, exit when momentum turns; a wide 4xATR catastrophic stop, no take profit, no break-even or ratchet, no structural genes. Nothing here was optimised.
preregistration.role: The bar every research strategy must beat on the forward test. It is never re-optimised and never removed from the forward book. Since 2026-11-22 (owner's decision) the same configuration also trades on demo as the core sleeve core-tsmom-4h-30d; the benchmark record stays the forward book's.
preregistration.decision_rule: Research is only worth its complexity if the top quartile's forward return beats this benchmark over the same period (reported in /api/forward).

provenance.selected_on: Family chosen on this system's own OOS results; the standard monthly TSMOM horizon, not fitted.

seen_data.what: the lab's walk-forward history of the tsmom family: 365-day training + 360-day OOS before each run (1h from 20.11.2026, 4h from 21.11.2026)
the choice itself: tsmom became the benchmark and the core because it was the only family with a non-negative mean OOS Sharpe in 215 lab trials (METHOD_REVIEW, 21.11.2026)

provenance.clean_evidence: Clean evidence is the forward test from the freeze only. A one-off read on any period before the freeze is a replication: it can reject, never confirm (the same rule as clean_oos). PLAN B4's 'sealed last 12 months' is not sealed for this configuration.
